metadata.value: Team DETR leverages query collaboration and position constraints to embrace objects of interest more precisely, dynamically catering to each query member's prediction preference with better scale and spatial priors; it can be adapted to other DETR variants without increasing parameters and calculations.
metadata.normalized_value: Team DETR leverages query collaboration and position constraints to embrace objects of interest more precisely, dynamically catering to each query member's prediction preference with better scale and spatial priors; it can be adapted to other DETR variants without increasing parameters and calculations.
metadata.evidence:
To alleviate this issue, we propose Team DETR, which leverages query collaboration
and position constraints to embrace objects of interest more precisely. We also dynamically cater to each query member's
prediction preference, offering the query better scale and spatial priors. In addition, the proposed Team DETR is
flexible enough to be adapted to other existing DETR variants without increasing parameters and calculations.
metadata.reason: Describes the core method and its key property, helping users understand the artifact's contribution.

metadata.value: Three groups with proportions 65%, 20%, and 15%, corresponding to relative scales (0, 0.2], (0.2, 0.4], and (0.4, 1]; set via --q_splits; --matcher options are ori (HungarianMatcher) and team (TeamHungarianMatcher)
metadata.normalized_value: Three groups with proportions 65%, 20%, and 15%, corresponding to relative scales (0, 0.2], (0.2, 0.4], and (0.4, 1]; set via --q_splits; --matcher options are ori (HungarianMatcher) and team (TeamHungarianMatcher)
metadata.evidence:
In default, we divide the queries into three groups, with the proportions of 65%, 20%, and 15%, corresponding to the
relative scales of (0, 0.2], (0.2, 0.4], and (0.4, 1], respectively. `--q_splits` is to set the proportion of each
group. `--matcher` has two options, `ori`(original HungarianMatcher) and `team`(TeamHungarianMatcher).
metadata.reason: Documents the key hyperparameters and configuration options of the method.
